# Henrick F.

> Independent product and AI builder. I build AI automations and custom apps for B2B companies, with the operational depth to know which problems are actually worth solving.

I'm a hybrid GTM/RevOps operator and AI/product builder. The last 6+ years: scaling revenue and operations at venture-backed fintech, edtech, and AI startups across LATAM. MBA from IPADE Business School; BS in Industrial Engineering from Universidad Iberoamericana. Currently a partner at Clearframe Labs, operating MatchWise (an AI applicant tracking system), and taking on a small number of independent engagements per quarter.

The angle: most AI builders don't have a $15M book of business in their past. Most GTM operators can't ship the tool that fixes the problem they just diagnosed. The overlap is where I work.

## Services and pricing (USD)

Four engagement formats. Final price comes from a written scope after a discovery conversation. No hourly billing surprises.

- **Build engagement.** Fixed-scope, milestone-based, 6 to 12 weeks typical. Milestones from $20K.
- **Prototype sprint.** Fixed price, 2 to 4 weeks. From $10K. A working demo wired to your real data, an honest go/no-go, and a build plan for v1.
- **Advisory retainer.** Monthly, 3-month minimum. From $4K/month. GTM, RevOps, or AI-product leadership at a fractional cadence.
- **Audit & assessment.** Fixed deliverable, 1 to 2 weeks. From $3K. Diagnostic on AI roadmap, ops stack, GTM motion, or product positioning.

Engagements above ~$30K, or that need a dedicated team and a US Product Owner, route through Clearframe Labs (https://www.clearframelabs.co), where I am a partner. Same scoping conversation, different delivery shape.

## Selected work

- [Findably](https://henrickf.com/projects/findably): AI SEO/GEO content engine. Subscription product ($150/mo, 30 articles/month, 40+ languages).
- [Konfetti](https://henrickf.com/projects/konfetti): Online dating for wedding guests. 50+ weddings, 1000+ matches.
- [MatchWise](https://henrickf.com/projects/matchwise): AI applicant tracking system. 80 to 90% screening-time reduction, 60% inference-cost reduction.
- [Rodada](https://henrickf.com/projects/rodada): Mobile-billboard ops platform with custom ERP/CMS. 2,000+ trailers managed; clients include Jeeves, AXA, Stori, Essity.
- [Nova Realty Cocoyoc](https://henrickf.com/projects/nova-realty): WhatsApp-first real estate platform with self-serve property CMS.
- [Mexico por el Clima](https://henrickf.com/projects/mexico-por-el-clima): Year-round digital platform for the NGO behind Mexico's Climate Action Week. Clearframe joint build; targeting October 2026 launch.
- [Service Core](https://henrickf.com/projects/service-core): Accounting integration automation. Saves 20+ hours/week of manual ledger reconciliation. Clearframe joint build.
- [Tivos](https://henrickf.com/projects/tivos): B2B commodity trader public site (Wix v1 live; Next.js v2 in build).

## Career

- 2026 to present: Partner, Clearframe Labs. Client-facing scoping and engagement structuring on B2B AI and custom-software builds.
- 2025 to present: Director of Operations & GTM, MatchWise.
- 2023 to 2025: Director of Strategy & Operations, Bedu (Lottus Education, one of Mexico's leading higher-education groups). Enterprise accounts including HSBC, Santander, Novartis, and Accenture.
- 2021 to 2023: BDM into Head of Sales, Mexico, Jeeves (a16z, YC). Contributed customer-data analysis and research to the Series C deck, ~$180M raised at a $2.1B valuation.
- 2020 to 2021: Senior Consultant, KoreFusion (Mexico and Singapore). Advised on 100+ fintechs across LATAM, EMEA, and the US.
- Summer 2019: MBA Summer Associate, Operations, BBVA.
